summary: A Riyadh aesthetic clinic appears to lose consultations because its main button goes nowhere and no phone or address appears.

findings.problem: The main Get Started button appears to link to #, and the Treatments, Weight Loss and Laser Treatment menu items appear to link to #.
findings.cost: Patients ready to book hit a dead end.
findings.fix: A working booking button and menu pages.

findings.problem: About ten submenu items appear to be labelled Menu Item and link to #, and all five doctor profile links appear empty.
findings.cost: Placeholder menus make the clinic look unfinished and hide your doctors.
findings.fix: Real labels and doctor profile pages.

findings.problem: No phone number, address or opening hours appear on the page.
findings.cost: Patients cannot call, visit or know when you are open.

findings.problem: The same testimonial appears twice, doctor bios appear to end in ellipses, and no before and after results appear.
findings.cost: Thin and repeated proof does not convince patients for high value procedures.
findings.fix: Real reviews, full doctor bios and a results gallery.
